title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 339 (Liability for fraudulent conduct of business)

content.overview: If in the course of the winding up of a company it appears that any business of the company has been carried on with intent to defraud creditors of the company or any other persons or for any fraudulent purpose, the Tribunal, on the application of the Official Liquidator, Company Liquidator, creditor or contributory, may declare that any person who is or has been a director, manager or officer of the company, or any persons who were knowingly parties to the carrying on of the business in that manner, shall be personally responsible, without any limitation of liability, for all or any of the debts or other liabilities of the company as the Tribunal may direct. Knowingly parties are also liable under section 447.
content.glance: Fraudulent trading: Tribunal may impose unlimited personal liability on directors/officers/knowing parties for company debts where business was carried on with intent to defraud or for a fraudulent purpose.
content.study: Section 339 is the fraudulent trading provision. Where business has been carried on with intent to defraud creditors or others, or for any fraudulent purpose, the Tribunal may, on application by the Official Liquidator, Company Liquidator, a creditor or a contributory, declare that directors, managers, officers or knowing parties are personally responsible without limitation of liability for such debts or liabilities as the Tribunal directs. The Tribunal may give further directions to give effect to the declaration, including charging the liability on debts or securities held by the person. Knowingly parties are also liable to action under section 447. The section applies notwithstanding criminal liability under other law.

examples.title: Continued trading while insolvent
examples.body: Directors continue to trade and incur credit after the company is clearly insolvent, with intent to prefer some creditors. On winding up the Tribunal may declare them personally liable under s. 339 for specified debts.

hypotheticals.question: Who may apply under s. 339?
hypotheticals.analysis: The Official Liquidator, the Company Liquidator, any creditor or any contributory of the company.
